roxmltree 0.21.1: embedded ego-tree tree structure
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

roxmltree 0.21.1 src/lib.rs lines 8-9 state that its tree structure is a heavily
modified <https://github.com/causal-agent/ego-tree> and gives "License: ISC".
The roxmltree package metadata does not identify this embedded upstream notice.

License-text provenance: official causal-agent/ego-tree repository, LICENSE at
commit 44a220eaad3e33fded661d435ffc82bbcdcea266
<https://github.com/causal-agent/ego-tree/blob/44a220eaad3e33fded661d435ffc82bbcdcea266/LICENSE>.
The roxmltree source names the repository but does not pin this exact ego-tree
commit; this paragraph does not claim that it does.

resvg 0.48.1: Getreuer Gaussian IIR blur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

resvg 0.48.1 src/filter/iir_blur.rs contains:

// An IIR blur.
//
// Based on http://www.getreuer.info/home/gaussianiir
//
// Licensed under 'Simplified BSD License'.

The resvg package metadata does not identify this embedded upstream notice.

Implementation provenance: resvg source at linebender/resvg commit
68b14c4c3bccdb60344c777406486b54c36ec1a4, crate resvg 0.48.1.
resvg attributes the blur to Pascal Getreuer's gaussianiir and to the
Alvarez-Mazorra algorithm described in the source comments.

License-text provenance: Pascal Getreuer's gaussian_conv_am.c header and
BSD_simplified.txt from the 20131215 archive linked from the author's official
IPOL code page:
<https://www.ipol.im/pub/art/2013/87/gaussian_20131215.tgz>
Archive SHA256: 9458287AC105D51E60D87A69A6B9107D7540ADD2FCAB362BD5EE18F359219DFD
The resvg source says it is based on the older gaussianiir project and does not
pin this archive version; this notice does not claim exact historical-version
identity.

Upstream source header (verbatim):

 * <http://www.opensource.org/licenses/bsd-license.html>.

The upstream source offers the GNU GPL version 3 or later OR the simplified
BSD license. License selected for the Getreuer-derived code: Simplified BSD.
